origin: User-supplied Demon Mask GLB. Original 5686-triangle topology, normals, UVs and three material maps retained; embedded 4096px textures resized to 1024px by prepare-switch-it-mask.mjs. Portrait registration and solid red material treatment are applied at runtime.
